_how_to_fill_this_in: 1. In the client's instance: Setup and Maintenance > Manage Descriptive Flexfields.
2. Search the flexfield code for the level you need:
header PO_HEADERS | line PO_LINES | schedule PO_LINE_LOCATIONS | distribution PO_DISTRIBUTIONS
3. Edit > Manage Contexts > open the context the client uses > look at its segments.
4. For each segment copy TWO things: the Prompt (becomes 'name') and the
Column Name (becomes 'attribute'). They are unrelated - a segment prompted
'Project Code' can sit in ATTRIBUTE12. Never guess the column name.
5. Note the Context Code once per level (becomes 'context'). A row can carry
6. Delete every field below that the client does not have.

fields.name: Budget Owner
fields.guide: Department that owns the budget for this purchase order. Pick from the list - these are the values configured in your Oracle instance.

fields.name: Contract Reference
fields.guide: Reference of the framework contract this PO was raised against in the legacy system. Leave blank if the PO was standalone.

fields.name: Budget Year
fields.guide: Financial year the spend is booked against, as a four digit year.

fields.name: Original Request Date
fields.guide: Date the purchase was originally requested in the legacy system, as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: Asset Class
fields.guide: Asset classification used for capital reporting. Pick from the list. This one deliberately has a long value set, to show that a list too long for an inline drop-down is written to the hidden Lists sheet instead.

fields.name: Site Contact
fields.guide: Name and phone number of the person to contact when this delivery arrives on site.

fields.name: Cost Centre Owner
fields.guide: Person accountable for the cost centre this distribution is charged to.
